items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: I learned that Milt Hinton and Bucky Pizzarelli both played on Del Shannon’s “The Wanderer.”

ctx.x: Yeah, exactly. She was great. She tried to get me to play with a pick, which I never — she really loved playing with a pick. Because she was actually an excellent jazz guitar player. I don’t think a lot of people know that about her. And another thing that was kind of cool too is she impressed upon me how most of the people that were in The Wrecking Crew were jazz players. They wanted to play jazz. But they started getting all this studio work and cha-chang. You know. The money was coming in.

That’s interesting you say that because I think the same thing was happening in New York. The other day for instance, I learned that Milt Hinton and Bucky Pizzarelli both played on Del Shannon’s “The Wanderer.” CF:: Unreal.
And those guys just did that, day after day.
